source_files: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.17637v1 (Figure 1 text layer; Appendix D.1 File Structure)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/SCBench/CommentarySet_full_data (gated: 403, our token is not on the authorized list)
access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data needs the HF access request: contact information, academic research only, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)
note: Our HF token has no access to CommentarySet_full_data (auto-approval gate, not accepted on the user's behalf), so no JSON record or clip was read. The only verbatim ground-truth text is the six GT commentaries in the paper's Figure 1, one per SCORES dimension, each from a different clip (sports not stated per quote), plus the field list of *_final.json in Appendix D.1. Each real record is one clip (mean 14.5 s) with one merged commentary passage, so there is no within-clip timeline.

examples.title: Paper Figure 1: six ground-truth commentaries, one per commentary dimension
examples.raw:
① Key Events:
GT Commentary: "And Carescus makes the first free throw.  And the second."
② Technical Detail
GT Commentary: "The more horizontal the bat is when it comes into contact with the ball, the more side spin."
③ Background Info
GT Commentary: "Well, this woman leads the world this year with a 493 vault earlier in the week."
④ Tactical Analysis
GT Commentary: "hey're in the same team, and different roles. They haven't always been two strikers in a 4-4-2."
⑤ Match Situation
GT Commentary: "First time, really,  they've been able to find their centre forward in the box."
⑥ Emotional Expression
GT Commentary: "These players are so super fit they could play all afternoon."

examples.title: Paper Appendix D.1: fields of each record in <sport>_final.json
examples.raw:
id : The id of the clip, where each clip has a unique id. The structure is "video_id" + "-" + "clip_id" . For example, the clip with the id "003-992" in athletics_final.json represents clip 992 of video 003 in athletics.
category : The sports category to which the video in the clip belongs.
timestamp ( start_time & end_time ): The start and end timestamps of the clip in the original video.
text : The ground truth commentary corresponding to the clip.
label : The six-dimensional label corresponding to the clip.
